articles.summary: Checkr now owns both Truework and Truv, and Equifax has absorbed Vault Verify, so the Argyle alternatives list looks different than it did a year ago. Here are the six main options, the three models they represent, and why coverage claims and completion rates are not the same number.
articles.title: Best Argyle Alternatives for Employment Verification (2026)

articles.summary: Healthcare background check requirements stack five core checks: criminal history, federal exclusion lists, licensure, employment and education history, and abuse registries. Which apply depends on the role and the state. This guide maps them and shows where the process stalls.
articles.title: Healthcare Background Screening: Requirements by Role
